id: WI: Wisconsin Question 1 - Prohibit Partial Veto to Create or Increase Taxes or Fees
ballot_name: Wisconsin Question 1 - Prohibit Partial Veto to Create or Increase Taxes or Fees
measure: Wisconsin Prohibit Partial Veto to Increase Tax or Fee Amendment
description: Amend the Wisconsin Constitution to prohibit the governor from using the partial veto to create or increase any tax or fee.

id: WI: Wisconsin Question 2 - Prohibit Closing Places of Worship During Emergencies
ballot_name: Wisconsin Question 2 - Prohibit Closing Places of Worship During Emergencies
measure: Wisconsin Prohibit Government Closure of Places of Worship During Emergencies Amendment
description: Prohibit the state or any political subdivision from ordering the closure of or forbidding gatherings in places of worship in response to a state of emergency, including public health emergencies.

id: WI: Wisconsin Question 3 - Prohibit Government Discrimination or Preferential Treatment
ballot_name: Wisconsin Question 3 - Prohibit Government Discrimination or Preferential Treatment
measure: Wisconsin Prohibit Government Discrimination or Preferential Treatment Amendment
description: Prohibit any governmental entity from discriminating or granting preferential treatment based on race, sex, color, ethnicity, or national origin in public employment, public education, public contracting, or public administration.

id: WY: Wyoming Proposition 1 - Homeowner Primary Residence Property Tax Exemption
ballot_name: Wyoming Proposition 1 - Homeowner Primary Residence Property Tax Exemption
measure: Wyoming Homeowner's Primary Residence Property Tax Exemption Initiative
description: Allows eligible homeowners to exempt 50% of their primary residence's assessed value from property taxes.
